DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED paired active references (setups, account preferences, favorites) must remain deferrable.
Former bags model is still referenced by shot composite FK; preserve history, no dead-table conclusion.
Storage-managed FK DDL cannot establish external Storage API reachability or policy behavior.
